VPL_v4.rule: F7 (natural instances, exact truth): routed optimal > best constituent optimal, routed wrong <= best constituent wrong, one-sided exact sign test over discordant held-out items p < 0.05, routed median latency <= 60 s and <= 10x the best constituent's median. Best constituent chosen on held-out results (most optimal, then fewest wrong). Practitioner, compiled-arm and per-network comparisons reported, not part of the rule. VPL = families meeting their rule.

limits: real topologies, link lengths, demand pairs and ECMP loads; module size, utilisation target, admissible paths, lease prices, arc limit and budget are a declared planning layer, not SNDlib's own capacities or costs
the truth is the exact optimum of the declared problem, not a realised outcome
items within one network share its topology; the item sign test treats them as independent, so a per-network sign test is reported alongside
practitioner arms run in process, outside GREG's isolated workers; their latency is not comparable with the GREG arms'
one container; latency is this machine's
